# Faux ACP

A plugin that only describes a harness: the fake ACP agent of `tests/fixtures/fake-acp.mjs` (found on the PATH as
`fake-acp`, `tests/fixtures/acp-bin/`), served by the generic ACP plugin `dev.escouade.acp`. Not a line of code: the
bench of the harnesses, the tests of the core and the e2e play it from this manifest.
